surface: Octane Inertia 3.6.1 adapter foundation: framework-neutral router, HTTP client, progress, and server exports reuse @inertiajs/core unchanged; page, remember, poll, prefetch, form-state, router-submit, direct-HTTP, precognition, and layout-property hooks are ported to Octane.
divergences: React, ReactDOM, StrictMode, forwardRef, and synthetic events are not runtime dependencies; the Octane adapter uses Octane roots, refs-as-props, and native events.
ssr: The framework-neutral Inertia server entry is exposed. Hook initialization is request-local and covered in the server runtime; Octane page rendering and hydration are completed by the adapter SSR unit.
